text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Toronto and East York Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. To report on the request received on May 4, 2018 from 1945304 Ontario Inc., operating as The Crafty Coyote Ale House, for an extension of operating hours of the boulevard café permit located at 511 Bloor Street West, Borden Street flankage.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the request for an extension of operating hours of the boulevard café permit located at 511 Bloor Street West, Borden Street flankage with the following conditions: a. There shall be no amplified music or entertainment allowed on the patio and care must be taken to damp down any music that might spill into the community from inside the restaurant through open doors to the patio; b. The patio will be closed and cleared by 11:00 p.m. from Sunday to Thursday, and 12:00 a.m. on Friday and Saturday; c. Patrons shall only enter and exit the patio through the restaurant; there will be no entrance or exit from the patio itself on to Borden Street; d.
